new.title: Dine in the Winzerstube zum Becher in Meersburg
new.desc: Winzer-cooperative tavern in the old town of Meersburg, serving only wines of the Winzerverein Meersburg alongside regional cooking. Fodor's lists it among the town's best restaurants.
new.tip: Reserve ahead, especially in summer and on weekends. Pair a Müller-Thurgau or Spätburgunder from the lake with a lake fish dish.

new.title: Order Felchen in almond butter at the Badische Weinstube
new.desc: The Markgräflich Badische Weinstube is a wine tavern in Meersburg's lower town, linked to the Margraves of Baden's wine estate. Guidebooks single out lake Felchen in almond butter and the saffron fish soup.
new.tip: Ask for the Meersburg Spätburgunder Weißherbst, the area's signature rosé-style wine. Call ahead on 07532 49642.

new.title: Eat at the Gasthof zum Bären under Meersburg's upper gate
new.desc: The Gasthof zum Bären stands at the Obertor in Meersburg's Marktplatz and is a 17th-century inn with its own restaurant. It has a Wikipedia entry and is a long-running address for regional cooking above the lake.
new.tip: Closed for dinner on some days, so check the hours. Combine with a walk through the old town to the castle.

new.title: Try Felchen matjes at the Seehalde above Birnau
new.desc: Lakeside hotel restaurant at Birnau-Maurach, run by the Gruler brothers and listed in the Michelin guide for seasonal, regional cooking. Lake fish is a focus, including house-made marinated Felchen and a fish soup with rouille.
new.tip: Reserve a terrace table in summer, as they are in demand. Mains run roughly 30 to 48 euros.

new.title: Eat at the Krone brewery inn in Tettnang
new.desc: Brauerei und Gasthof zur Krone on Bärenplatz has been run by the Tauscher family for seven generations since 1847. It brews its own beer in the centre of the hop town and is known for seasonal and game dishes.
new.tip: Try the house beer with a regional main. Game dishes are the autumn highlight.
new.q: Brauerei Gasthof zur Krone, Bärenplatz 7, Tettnang

new.title: Drink Hirsch beer at the brewery tavern in Wurmlingen
new.desc: The Hirsch-Brauerei Honer in Wurmlingen was founded in 1782 to supply the Hirschen inn and is still family-owned. The Brauereigaststätte serves lunch and dinner, and the brewery runs tours and a small beer museum.
new.tip: Book the Hirsch-Bierwelt tour with tasting of five beers in advance on 07461 942-0. Part of the DonauBierland programme.

new.title: Have dinner at the Gasthaus Löwen in Villingen's old town
new.desc: Gasthaus Löwen on Obere Straße, in the walled old town of Villingen, serves crossover regional cooking. Its menu was updated in 2026 and it opens for lunch and dinner.
new.tip: Closed on Mondays. The old town's Obere Straße is a short walk from the Münster.

new.title: Sit on the terrace of the Malereck at the Langenargen marina
new.desc: Restaurant Malereck stands at the BMK Yachthafen on Langenargen's lakefront, with a terrace and regional cooking. It is close to Schloss Montfort and the Argen mouth.
new.tip: Choose a table outside on summer evenings. Fish from the lake is the natural choice.

new.title: Order Black Forest trout in the Ochsenstube in Triberg
new.desc: The Ochsenstube is the restaurant of the Parkhotel Wehrle in Triberg, a family-run house dating to 1707 and known for its trout dishes. Local lore says Hemingway enjoyed its specialities.
new.tip: Open daily for lunch and dinner. Reserve for dinner in high season.
new.q: Ochsenstube, Parkhotel Wehrle, Gartenstraße 24, Triberg im Schwarzwald

new.title: Share a Brettvesper at the Wirtshaus Alt-Tryberg
new.desc: Traditional Wirtshaus on Triberg's main street serving Black Forest ham, cold roast and Schäufele on a Brett-Vesper board. The menu was updated in March 2025.
new.tip: Order the Brettvesper platter with bread and mustard. Good stop before or after the waterfalls.
new.q: Wirtshaus Alt-Tryberg, Hauptstraße 53, Triberg im Schwarzwald

new.title: Dine at the Gasthaus Jägerhaus in the Danube valley
new.desc: Family-run inn in the Upper Danube valley near Fridingen, open since 1902 and now in its fourth generation. It is a partner of the DonauBierland programme with Hirsch beer menus.
new.tip: Check the opening days before going, as Monday is a rest day. Popular with hikers on the Danube trails.
new.q: Gasthaus Jägerhaus, Bronnen 7, Fridingen an der Donau
